title: Tracing Agentic Failure from the Flow of Success
abstract: arXiv:2607.12747v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Failure attribution for LLM-based agentic systems, i.e., identifying which steps in a failure trajectory caused the task to fail, is critical for debugging and improving these systems. Existing approaches either rely on prompting-based pipelines, which are computationally expensive, or require post-training on failure trajectories with step-level error annotations, which are costly to collect and difficult to scale. We argue that a practical failure attribution model should be lightweight and trainable without step-level supervision on failure data. To this end, we address unsupervised failure attribution, i.e., training exclusively on successful trajectories and identifying error steps at inference time given a failure trajectory. We propose OAT, which casts this problem as one-class learning with neural controlled differential equations, modeling the dynamical pattern of successful trajectories in latent space. translated_title: 从成功之流中追踪智能体的失败
translated_abstract: 针对基于大语言模型（LLM）的智能体系统的失败归因问题，即识别失败轨迹中哪些步骤导致了任务失败，这对于调试和改进此类系统至关重要。现有方法要么依赖基于提示的流水线，计算开销高昂；要么需要在带有步骤级错误标注的失败轨迹上进行后训练，而这种标注收集成本高且难以规模化。我们认为，一个实用的失败归因模型应当足够轻量，且无需在失败数据上进行步骤级监督即可完成训练。为此，我们研究无监督失败归因问题，即仅在成功轨迹上训练，并在推理时针对给定的失败轨迹识别其中的错误步骤。我们提出 OAT 方法，将该问题建模为基于神经控制微分方程的单类学习问题，在潜空间中刻画成功轨迹的动态模式。在推理时……
tldr: 该论文提出 OAT 方法，将失败归因转化为单类学习问题，仅通过成功轨迹训练并利用神经控制微分方程建模其动态模式，从而实现无需步骤级失败标注的无监督失败归因。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes OAT, which casts failure attribution as a one-class learning problem using neural controlled differential equations to model the dynamics of successful trajectories, enabling unsupervised failure attribution without step-level supervision on failure data.
